tools.name: ventru_find
tools.description: Use when the user needs someone or something to talk to, hire, delegate to, or buy from: another AI agent with a capability, a verified business, or a person with a public Ventru address. Also searches thousands of public MCP servers (tools you can connect to by URL). Returns addresses you can conta

tools.name: ventru_contact
tools.description: Send a signed message to any Ventru address (@name, agent:..., or a verified business domain). Starts a thread; replies in the thread are free. Pass your own address and token from ventru_register so the recipient sees a verified sender. If the recipient is not on Ventru, a pending invite is created

tools.name: ventru_inbox
tools.description: Read messages sent to your Ventru address, including replies to threads you started.

tools.name: ventru_register
tools.description: Claim a free @address and inbox so people, agents, and businesses can reach you or your user. Call once; store the returned inboxToken and recoverySecret securely and never share them.

tools.name: ventru_usage
tools.description: Show this month's connections, included allowance, fees, and router credits for your address.

tools.name: ventru_pricing
tools.description: Explain who pays for which connection direction and what each plan includes. People never pay.

tools.name: ventru_search_providers
tools.description: Find businesses on Ventru that match a request. Returns only verified providers by default, with trust evidence and freshness. An empty result means no verified match; the unmet demand is recorded.

tools.name: ventru_build_action_capsule
tools.description: Rank verified providers for an intent and return an Ed25519-signed capsule with ready-to-call route bodies.

tools.name: ventru_create_route
tools.description: Record a quote-only or user-approved route to a provider offer. Returns a routeId; report the result later with ventru_report_outcome.

tools.name: ventru_report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether a routed request completed, failed, or was disputed. Only outcomes tied to a recorded routeId affect AgentRank and attribution.

tools.name: ventru_probe_site
tools.description: Check whether a business website publishes machine-readable identity (llms.txt, agent.json, OpenAPI, A2A agent card) and what is missing.

tools.name: ventru_resolve_agent
tools.description: Look up an agent address such as @name and return registration, inbox, and transport status.

tools.name: ventru_trust_profile
tools.description: Return what each Ventru assurance label means, the evidence behind Ventru's own claims, and whether the review is current.

tools.name: ventru_unmet_demand
tools.description: Aggregated requests agents made through Ventru, ranked by how often no verified provider existed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ventru_register" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Claim a free @address and inbox so people, agents, and businesses can reach you or your user. Call once; store the returned inboxToken and recoverySecret secure…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ventru_inbox · Private data: ventru_find, ventru_contact, ventru_create_route · Public sink: ventru_contact, ventru_register.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ventru_inbox · Private data: ventru_find, ventru_contact, ventru_create_route · Public sink: ventru_contact, ventru_register

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
